title: Chapter 291
text:
At the edge of the crowd, Li Ge frowned slightly.

Most of the players were pleasantly surprised that Han Xiao was selling class advancement knowledge, but Li Ge was not happy at all. He already had another class advancement knowledge, which the Guild of Gods had helped him farm with all their resources. Li Ge was going to use it as his trump card to shine in the competition.

However, Han Xiao's actions had greatly reduced the effect of his trump card, which reduced the gap between him and the others. It was not surprising that everyone had something.

Li Ge stared at Han Xiao, his eyes flashing. No one knew what he was thinking.

A few gods were chatting beside him. Second Prince boasted proudly, "With a god like me, leading Dynasty into the finals will be a piece of cake. Old Wang, don't you think I still need to be merciful and bring him along?"

Sun Eggplant looked at him with disdain. "If you don't have King Generals, your Dynasty is nothing."

Second Prince was furious. The two of them exchanged a few words. At this time, Li Ge walked over and smiled. "It's good to have confidence. I hope that everyone can practice well. I need help in the international competition to win glory for China."

The others curled their lips. They were disgusted by Li Ge's self-proclaimed leadership. Hao Tian said directly, "I don't like you representing others. Mind your own business."

Li Ge's smile disappeared. He looked at Hao Tian and said calmly, "Then I'll see you in the competition. Don't let me win too easily."

There was a smell of gunpowder between the two of them. Sparks seemed to fly when they looked at each other.

Suddenly, a lazy voice came from the side. "Dumbass, I found you. Come back to the team with me for training."

Everyone turned around to look. A bearded male player walked over. He looked very sloppy and unkempt. The ID above his head was "King Generals". This person was the low-key and mysterious number one professional player in China, the core of Dynasty. He had a resounding nickname:

The Emperor!

"Don't call me dumbass!" Second Prince was unhappy.

"Okay, dumbass." King Generals nodded.

"Ah, bastard!" Second Prince was easily angered when he saw the god of his own team. He said angrily, "Don't be so arrogant. Sooner or later, I'll ride on your back and do whatever I want!"

Eh!

Everyone had looks of disdain on their faces.

King Admiral looked like he was still half asleep. He nodded and dragged Second Prince away by his collar. He did not greet the others and just did what he wanted to do. He was not very sociable, but in Li Ge's eyes, it was arrogance.

Looking at King Admiral's back, Li Ge's eyes flashed. He snorted inwardly. He coveted the number one position of King Admiral. Only by obtaining the number one position could his career progress further.

"We can't afford to lose this time."

Everyone looked at each other and saw the determination in each other's eyes.

…

After three days of trading, Han Xiao's Experience Points had reached an astronomical figure of 1,000,000,000! Including the original 500 million, he now had a total of 1.5 billion experience points!

The amount of experience points I have will determine how long I can stay in the galaxy. I don't need to worry about experience points. My next round of growth will be among the stars. Only with enough experience can I grasp the opportunity and grow quickly. After Level 70, the amount of experience points I need will become higher and higher. Furthermore, I'm a Mechanic that consumes a lot of experience points. After entering the galaxy, there will be very few chances to meet a large number of players.

Han Xiao thought about his future. Although he had a lot of experience points now, once he entered the galaxy, they would all be used up one day. Since he was destined to run out of experience points, he would try his best to make this mountain as high as possible.

Bang!

Outside the window, a firework rose into the sky from the direction of the arena and exploded.

This sound signaled the official start of the Pro League!

The boiling cheers blended into a huge sound wave and spread out.

Looking down at the arena, Han Xiao saw that the arena had been modified into a stadium-like structure. In the middle were nine small arenas surrounding a large arena. At the edge of the arena was a large screen, and below the screen was the commentator's seat. Around the arena was the audience seats. At this time, the arena was filled with people, and there were no empty seats. The cheers rose and fell like waves, instantly igniting the atmosphere of the event.

"It's starting." Han Xiao lay on the sofa, changed into a more comfortable position, and opened the forums to watch the live broadcast.

There were tens of millions of people watching the broadcast like him!

The beautiful female host, 'Red Phoenix', had a professional smile on her face. She stood on the highest arena and gave the opening speech. Her clear and pleasant voice echoed in the arena through the loudspeaker. "The first Galaxy Pro League, Blue Star division, the qualifiers officially begin!

"We have 2,759 teams and 104652 players registered. The teams will fight in the wild, and the arena is the venue for the individual competition. These arenas will be the venues for the contestants to battle each other! "One battle elimination system, the loser will be eliminated, and the winner will enter the next round of the lottery until the top thirty-eight teams and the top sixty-two individuals are selected.

"The qualifiers will last for a month in the game. Yes, this will be a long competition, but the whole process will be broadcasted. The audience in front of the screen can freely choose which arena to broadcast, and our main room will randomly choose the arena with the best performance."

After Red Phoenix finished talking about the competition rules and the atmosphere, she pointed at the entrance.

"Then, next, we will bring the opening of the individual competition to everyone. Please welcome the two contestants!"

In the dark tunnel, Hao Tian and the contestant with the ID 'Star Chess' stepped out. The moment the two appeared, the atmosphere in the arena reached its climax! The audience's enthusiasm gushed out!

In order to ensure the atmosphere of the opening match, the two contestants were chosen from the professional players who registered. Hao Tian and Star Chess were chosen.

The two of them stepped onto the main arena. Red Phoenix stood in the middle and introduced, "The one on the right is very familiar to everyone. He is a veteran who has been in the eSports scene for nine years. He has been ranked in the top five of China's professional players many times. His battle record is brilliant, and his style is calm and steady. He is the core player of Long Sky Club, Hao Tian!

"The one on the left might be unfamiliar to you. He's a senior in the eSports scene and used to play for Temple of God. Back then, he was the core of the team, just like Li Ge is now. He retired five years ago, but now, he's back with the glory of the past and the determination to win. He's the one who re-signed with Temple of God — Star Chess!"

"Good luck!" The audience burst into cheers. Both sides had people supporting them. Star Chess's fan club was relatively smaller. He had retired for five years, and his popularity was almost gone. Star Chess raised his head and looked at his fan club. They were all old faces. He did not expect to still have a small group of die-hard fans after five years of retirement. Star Chess was touched and nodded at his fans.

When the fans saw this, they shouted even louder until they were hoarse.

After introducing both sides, Red Phoenix came up to interview Star Chess. She smiled and said, "Welcome back to the professional scene. How do you feel now?"

Star Chess's face was filled with emotions. "I miss it very much. I remember the days when I fought in the professional scene."

"We will always remember your brilliant battle record with Temple of God and that proud figure of yours." The Red Phoenix politely complimented and then asked, "This is the first competition held by Starcraft. Can you tell me how familiar you are with the game?"

"My condition is very good." Star Chess laughed. "I am confident that I can spar with anyone."

Red Phoenix chatted for a while more, and Star Chess answered with ease. He was experienced in dealing with the host.

Red Phoenix's eyes flashed. She had received a request to create a topic, so she asked, "I heard that after retiring, you invested your savings into a business. Your company filed for bankruptcy last year. Is this the reason for your return to the professional scene?"

Star Chess's expression did not change. "Of course not. The professional scene is where I made my name. I am back because I want to remember my roots. I am looking forward to sparring with the younger players. I hope to find some good seedlings and teach the younger players some experience. It will be helpful for them in the international scene."
